item.title: Syria arrests five former al-Assad-era officers over strikes on civilians
item.description: Former air officers, including an air force general, were arrested in a series of operations.

item.title: Russia labels Cannes-winning director Andrey Zvyagintsev a ‘foreign agent’
item.description: Acclaimed Russian film director who won 2026 Grand Prix award at Cannes, ⁠has been critical of the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Lebanese artist turns Israeli missile debris into art
item.description: In southern Lebanon, visual artist Lina Jouni transforms debris from Israeli missile strikes into pieces of art.

item.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW, Politico from the White House for ‘fake news’
item.description: The US president insists media outlets report 'fiction and lies' as he enforces new bans on White House access.

item.title: Two injured by Israeli shelling as troops advance in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israeli forces withdraw from outskirts of a town in southern Lebanon after a standoff with Lebanese forces.

item.title: England fast bowler Carse to face no charges over alleged nightclub assault
item.description: Derbyshire Police said they were investigating an alleged assault but have now decided no further action will be taken.

item.title: Pentagon resumes paused testosterone policy amid medical experts’ concerns
item.description: New policy mandates testosterone testing for US service members over 30, citing readiness while experts warn of risks.

item.title: Mexico’s Sheinbaum says she spoke with Trump as trade negotiations continue
item.description: Mexican president says she is seeking a decrease in tariffs as both countries seek new bilateral trade deal.

item.title: Do elections in Russia make a difference?
item.description: Millions of people are choosing a new lower house of Parliament.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Buffett will become chairman emeritus immediately and his son Howard will become chairman.

item.title: Russia’s drones threaten Kyiv-bound Western officials as war effort stalls
item.description: Russia strikes Ukraine’s border crossings with Poland and Moldova as its offensives peter out in the east.

item.title: Police clear Ceuta migrants off beaches in Spanish enclave
item.description: At least 10,000 of the 72,000 migrants who broke through fence from Morocco in July remain in the Spanish enclave.

item.title: Early in-person voting begins in the 2026 US midterm elections in Virginia
item.description: Virginia leads the way for in-person voting, reflecting a nationwide trend towards casting ballots before Election Day.

item.title: Sweden’s left-wing opposition leader begins efforts to form government
item.description: Magdalena Andersson will likely face several challenges as she tries to get Sweden's other left-wing parties to unite.

item.title: Iranians rally in biggest show of defiance against US since war began
item.description: Volunteers rallied through downtown Tehran to join campaign highlighting 'self-sacrifice' for Iran.

item.title: UEFA, CONCACAF challenge FIFA on reserves and demand $10m payout to members
item.description: Confederation chiefs call on Gianni Infantino to make $2.1bn payout to all FIFA's 211 member associations.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Netanyahu says he will ‘change the face of the Middle East
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he will ‘change the face of the Middle East’

item.title: More than 112,000 displaced by Yemen fighting; thousands flee to Djibouti
item.description: United Nations says 22 million people need humanitarian aid as conflict intensifies.

item.title: Nigerian forces fire at protesters rallying over deaths of detained miners
item.description: Government has promised to fully investigate after 37 miners died while being held in police custody in Niger State.

item.title: Police hit migrants with batons during camp transfer in Ceuta
item.description: Police in Ceuta used batons and fired shots into the air as they began moving migrants from beaches to a new camp.

item.title: Carrick brushes off questions over his Manchester United future
item.description: Michael Carrick says he expected tough season start as he rebuffs questions about his role as Manchester United manager.

item.title: Real Madrid President says Ceuta visit not related to ‘recent news’
item.description: Real Madrid stars including Kylian Mbappe rolled up T-shirts showing support for Ceuta, but President trip 'unrelated'.

item.title: Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe ends Nike partnership to join Swiss brand On
item.description: On, which is set to launch its first football boots next year, also appointed Thierry Henry as its football director.

item.title: New Bolivian cat claws its way into species list: What we meow
item.description: Purrfectly new to science: the first new wild cat found in over a century proves that cats do have nine (secret) lives.

item.title: Russia seizes assets of French firms, summons UK envoy over Ukraine support
item.description: Kremlin calls UK's support for Ukraine an endorsement of 'terrorism' after recent escalation in weapons supply.
